approved: Commonwealth Electoral Amendment (Foreign Political Donations) Bill 2016
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill would make it illegal for Australian political parties and candidates to accept money from overseas donors.
It would add a new rule to the Commonwealth Electoral Act 1918 banning donations from anyone defined as a 'foreign person' under the Foreign Acquisitions and Takeovers Act 1975.
Donations under $1,000 would be exempt, and a party or candidate that receives a banned donation would have 30 days to return it.
Bans donations from foreign sources to Australian political parties and candidates.
Requires repayment of prohibited donations within 30 days.
Australian political parties, candidates, and foreign donors.
